scientific_integrity: Mean-distance extremal bounds already in the literature are explicitly credited; new assertions are the full stochastic law, local branching CDF and sharp nonstar Wasserstein gap. Finite tests corroborate but do not prove the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Unit-length tree edges only; fixed edge count.
No variance-order claim or extension to cycles or heterogeneous edge lengths.
Historical priority uncertain for inaccessible early literature.
title: Sharp stochastic distance extremality and stability for equilateral metric trees
